# Data visualisation · 数据可视化

One home for everything chart-shaped: choosing the chart from the question, the guides that keep charts honest and readable, the libraries that draw them, dashboard and big-screen references, and palettes built for data.

46 resources, plus 3 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `python3 "$S/catalog.py" find` (`S` = `skills/design-studio/scripts`) searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Chart choice and design guides · 图表选择与设计指引

Start from the question the chart answers (compare, rank, part-to-whole, change over time), then follow one style guide for axes, labels and colour.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [From Data to Viz](https://www.data-to-viz.com) | Decision tree from data type to chart, with a caveats section on common mistakes | Start from the data shape (one or several numeric variables, categoric, numeric plus categoric, map, network, time series), follow the tree to two or three candidate charts, then read the Caveats page (ordering bars, spaghetti lines, dual axes, pie charts) before finalising. | S | guideline | static | free | [Caveats (graphic pitfalls)](https://www.data-to-viz.com/caveats.html) |
| [Urban Institute Data Visualization Style Guide](https://urbaninstitute.github.io/graphics-styleguide/) | The most complete public chart style guide: palette with hex values, type hierarchy, annotation, and rules per chart type, all on one static page | Copy its structure when writing the chart chapter of a design system: palette and its order, type sizes, titles and source lines, then one section per chart type; replace Urban's own brand values (Lato, #1696d2) with the product's. | S | guideline | static | free · Apache-2.0 · slow | [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/graphics-styleguide) |
| [FT Visual Vocabulary](https://ft-interactive.github.io/visual-vocabulary/) | Chart chooser organised by the relationship in the data (deviation, correlation, ranking, distribution, change over time, part-to-whole, spatial, flow) | Name the relationship first (deviation, correlation, ranking, distribution, change over time, magnitude, part-to-whole, spatial, flow), then pick from that column. The web version is a JavaScript app; agents should read the PDF poster, which also exists in simplified and traditional Chinese and Japanese. | S | guideline | js | free | [Poster PDF (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Financial-Times/chart-doctor/main/visual-vocabulary/Visual-vocabulary-en.pdf); [海报 PDF（简体中文）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Financial-Times/chart-doctor/main/visual-vocabulary/Visual-vocabulary-cn-simplified.pdf); [Source and all languages (GitHub, MIT)](https://github.com/Financial-Times/chart-doctor/tree/main/visual-vocabulary) |
| [Data Viz Project](https://datavizproject.com) | Large catalogue of chart types filterable by function, input and shape | Filter by Family, Input, Function or Shape to find a less obvious form, then check the chosen chart against FT Visual Vocabulary before committing. | A | pattern-library | static | free |  |
| [Carbon data visualization](https://carbondesignsystem.com/data-visualization/getting-started/) | Practical rules for enterprise charts: colour palettes, axes, legends, dashboards, accessibility | Read Color palettes (categorical order, sequential, alert), then Axes and labels, Legends and the Dashboards page; the categorical palettes come in a fixed order meant to be used as-is. | A | guideline | static | free | [Color palettes](https://carbondesignsystem.com/data-visualization/color-palettes/) |
| [Chartability](https://chartability.fizz.studio) | Audit heuristics for accessible data visualisation | Test a chart against the POUR-CAF principles (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust, compromising, assistive, flexible), starting with the critical tests: contrast, colour-only encoding, keyboard access, text alternatives and a data table. | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [Datawrapper blog and Academy](https://www.datawrapper.de/blog) | Working knowledge from the Datawrapper team on chart design, strongest on colour for data, plus the Academy's per-chart-type how-tos and a free chart, map and table tool | Start with 'Which color scale to use when visualizing data' and the rest of the colour series; use the Academy for chart-type conventions (bars, lines, maps, tables) and the tool itself to test a chart fast. | A | article | static | free | [Which color scale to use](https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/which-color-scale-to-use-in-data-vis); [Datawrapper Academy](https://www.datawrapper.de/academy); [Datawrapper (chart tool)](https://www.datawrapper.de) |
| [The Visual Display of Quantitative Information](https://www.edwardtufte.com/book/the-visual-display-of-quantitative-information/) | Tufte on data-ink, chartjunk and graphical integrity | Read the chapters on graphical integrity and data-ink before a dashboard critique; cite the lie factor and chartjunk by name. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Storytelling with Data](https://www.storytellingwithdata.com/books) | Practical business chart design and narrative | For decks and dashboards aimed at managers: remove clutter first, then focus attention with one accent colour and an action title that states the takeaway. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [ONS data visualisation guidance](https://service-manual.ons.gov.uk/data-visualisation) | UK Office for National Statistics guidance on charts, tables and colour: chart choice, accessible colour, titles, annotation and the specifications behind its published charts | Use for public-facing statistics where clarity and accessibility beat novelty; read the colour guidance and the chart-type pages before styling. | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [The Data Visualisation Catalogue (multi)](https://datavizcatalogue.com) | Chart-type catalogue searchable by function (comparison, distribution, part-to-whole, relationships) with anatomy, when-to-use notes and tool lists per chart | Use Search by Function when a less common chart might fit, and read the anatomy notes to name the parts in a spec. | A | pattern-library | static | free |  |
| [Fundamentals of Data Visualization](https://clauswilke.com/dataviz/) | Claus Wilke's complete book, free online: choosing visualisations, colour use and pitfalls, proportional ink, overlapping points, and figure design | Read the colour chapters (colour scales, common pitfalls of colour use) and 'The principle of proportional ink' before designing charts; the whole text is static HTML an agent can read. | A | book | static | free |  |
| [Material 2 data visualization](https://m2.material.io/design/communication/data-visualization.html) | Still one of the clearest overviews of chart selection, style, behaviour and dashboard layout | Read once as a primer on chart selection, style (colour, type, gridlines, labels), behaviour and dashboard layout, then apply one current style guide such as Urban's or Carbon's. | A | guideline | js | free · archived |  |

## Chart libraries · 图表库

Match the library to the stack and the chart's complexity; check commercial licences and verify APIs against the installed version.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Apache ECharts](https://echarts.apache.org) | Full-featured charting library that most Chinese dashboards and big-screen projects are built on, with a runnable examples gallery, a complete option reference and a theme builder | Open the closest example and edit its option live, then look up each key in the option reference; define colours, fonts and axis styles once in a theme (the theme builder exports JSON) instead of per chart. | S | library | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [Examples (live option editor)](https://echarts.apache.org/examples/en/index.html); [Option reference](https://echarts.apache.org/en/option.html); [Theme builder](https://echarts.apache.org/en/theme-builder.html); [使用手册（中文）](https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/zh/get-started/) |
| [Vega-Lite](https://vega.github.io/vega-lite/) | Declarative JSON grammar for interactive charts with a published JSON Schema, so an agent can emit a chart as data and validate it before rendering | Have the agent write a Vega-Lite spec (data, mark, encoding) instead of bespoke chart code, validate it against the schema, render with vega-embed, and set colours and fonts once in a config object; Altair produces the same specs from Python. | S | library | static | free · BSD-3-Clause | [Examples](https://vega.github.io/vega-lite/examples/); [GitHub](https://github.com/vega/vega-lite); API `https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json` |
| [AntV (zh)](https://antv.antgroup.com) | Ant Group's visualisation stack (statistical charts, graphs, maps) with design principles for data graphics | Read the design spec (设计价值观, 色板, 标题与注释, 标签) before picking G2 (statistical charts), G6 (graphs) or L7 (maps). Agents: /llms.txt links Markdown versions of every spec page. | A | library | static | free · MIT | [llms.txt (agent index, Markdown spec pages)](https://antv.antgroup.com/llms.txt); [设计价值观](https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/principles/basic/); [G2](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com) |
| [Tremor](https://tremor.so) | React and Tailwind components for charts and dashboards; the team joined Vercel in 2025 | Use for a quick analytical UI in a React and Tailwind stack, then restyle the defaults to the product's tokens. | A | library | static | free · Apache-2.0 · slow |  |
| [D3](https://d3js.org) | Low-level toolkit for bespoke data visualisation | Use Observable Plot for standard charts and D3 only for bespoke forms (custom layouts, force, geo projections); pick the needed d3-* modules rather than the whole bundle. | A | library | static | free · ISC |  |
| [VisActor (multi)](https://www.visactor.io) | ByteDance's visualisation suite: VChart (narrative charts), VTable (very large interactive tables), VMind (AI chart generation), with themes matching Semi and Arco | Choose it when a Chinese product already uses Semi or Arco, or needs tables with hundreds of thousands of rows; agents can read /llms.txt, which indexes the VChart and VTable docs. | A | library | static | free · MIT | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://www.visactor.io/llms.txt); [VChart](https://www.visactor.io/vchart) |
| [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org) | Simple, framework-agnostic canvas charts (eight core types) with good defaults and a large plugin ecosystem | Use for a handful of standard charts in any stack; set Chart.defaults (font, colour, grid) once to the product's tokens, and pick SVG-based libraries when charts need per-element accessibility. | A | library | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Recharts](https://recharts.github.io) | Composable React chart components on SVG; the engine behind shadcn/ui charts and therefore most AI-generated dashboards | Compose charts from <XAxis>, <Tooltip>, <Line> and similar components; when the project uses shadcn/ui, start from its chart blocks and retheme through the chart config and CSS variables. Version 3 changed the API; check the installed major. | A | library | static | free · MIT | [shadcn/ui charts (Recharts blocks)](https://ui.shadcn.com/charts); [GitHub](https://github.com/recharts/recharts) |
| [Observable Plot](https://observablehq.com/plot/) | Concise grammar-of-graphics chart library from the D3 team: marks, scales and facets with good defaults for exploratory and editorial charts | Reach for it before D3 for standard charts: one Plot.plot({marks: [...]}) call per chart; restyle through the style option and CSS, and drop to D3 only for custom layouts. | A | library | blocked | free · ISC | [GitHub](https://github.com/observablehq/plot) |
| [Highcharts](https://www.highcharts.com) | Mature commercial chart library with the strongest built-in accessibility module (keyboard, sonification, screen-reader descriptions), plus stock, map and Gantt products | Consider it for regulated or accessibility-critical products, and confirm the licence before any commercial use. | B | library | static | paid · Commercial (Highsoft Standard License); non-commercial use under separate terms |  |
| [visx](https://visx.airbnb.tech) | Airbnb's low-level React visualisation primitives on D3 (scales, shapes, axes, tooltips) for charts that must match a design system exactly | Use when a React product needs fully custom charts; compose only the primitives you need and style them with the product's tokens. | B | library | js | free · MIT | [GitHub](https://github.com/airbnb/visx) |

## Dashboards and big-screen · 仪表盘与大屏

Study the genre before laying one out: operational dashboards, analytical reports and big-screen data walls differ in density, refresh and viewing distance.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [AWS Cloudscape (home: app-ui)](https://cloudscape.design) | Patterns for complex cloud consoles: resource tables, create flows, dashboards, generative-AI patterns | Read Patterns for table views, create flows, dashboards and generative-AI features; agents can start from /llms.txt (package, install and component index). | A | system | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://cloudscape.design/llms.txt) |
| [Dashboard Design Patterns](https://dashboarddesignpatterns.github.io) | Research-based taxonomy of dashboard structures, page layouts, interactions and genres | Before drawing, pick the dashboard genre (the site lists them) and walk the patterns for data information, meta information, visual representation, page layout, screen space and interaction; the design trade-offs page helps argue density decisions. | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [The Big Book of Dashboards](https://www.bigbookofdashboards.com) | Real business dashboards grouped by scenario, each with expert critique of what works and why | Find the scenario closest to the brief (executive summary, operations, sales, health care) and borrow its layout logic; the site hosts the dashboards shown in the book. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [TanStack Table (home: code)](https://tanstack.com/table/latest) | Headless table and data-grid logic (sorting, filtering, grouping, pagination, virtualisation hooks) for React, Vue, Solid and Svelte | Use when a dense table must match your own design system; you own all markup and styling | A | library | static | free · MIT | [TanStack llms.txt](https://tanstack.com/llms.txt) |

| [DataV.GeoAtlas (zh)](https://datav.aliyun.com/portal/school/atlas/area_selector) | GeoJSON for China's administrative areas down to district level, the usual source for Chinese map charts in ECharts, AntV and big-screen tools | Pick the region in the selector or fetch it directly by adcode (100000 is the whole country, _full includes the child areas). | A | tool | js | free | API `https://geo.datav.aliyun.com/areas_v3/bound/{adcode}_full.json` |
| [Astro UX Design System (home: app-ui)](https://www.astrouxds.com) | Design system for space-operations consoles: status semantics, dark control-room UI, monitoring patterns | Reference for operations centres, monitoring walls and digital-twin consoles | B | system | static | free |  |

## Exemplary work and data journalism · 优秀作品与数据新闻

Published visualisations to learn narrative, annotation and restraint from.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Information is Beautiful Awards](https://www.informationisbeautifulawards.com) | Award showcase for ambitious visualisation and infographics | Browse past winners and shortlists by category for editorial-grade data storytelling. | A | gallery | static | free · slow |  |
| [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org) | Thousands of consistently designed, annotated interactive charts with sources and downloadable data | Study how titles, subtitles, notes and source lines make a chart self-explanatory; append .csv to any grapher URL to get the data behind it. | A | gallery | static | free · CC BY 4.0 (charts and data) | API `https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/{slug}.csv` |
| [The Pudding](https://pudding.cool) | Visual essays that explain ideas with data: the reference for scrollytelling and editorial interaction | Use for narrative data pages; note how each scroll step changes one thing and how annotation carries the argument. | A | gallery | static | free |  |
| [The Paper: Meishuke (澎湃新闻·美数课) (zh)](https://www.thepaper.cn/list_25635) | One of the most consistent Chinese data-journalism desks: explainers, infographics and data stories on current news | Study how Chinese headlines, annotation and vertical mobile-first layouts carry a data story; most pieces are designed for phone reading. | A | gallery | static | free |  |
| [Dataviz Inspiration](https://www.dataviz-inspiration.com) | Curated real-world data visualisations filterable by chart type | Filter by chart type, then study how each piece labels directly, annotates the key point and orders its data; it is a gallery, not a guide. | A | gallery | js | free |  |

## Palettes and colour for data · 数据配色与工具

Sequential, diverging and categorical schemes that stay distinct under colour-vision deficiency. Test them in real chart types.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ColorBrewer](https://colorbrewer2.org) | Research-based sequential, diverging and qualitative schemes for maps and charts | Choose the nature of the data (sequential, diverging, qualitative) and the number of classes, tick 'colorblind safe' and 'print friendly', then export HEX, RGB or a JS array. | S | tool | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/axismaps/colorbrewer) |
| [How to pick the least wrong colors](https://mattstromawn.com/writing/how-to-pick-the-least-wrong-colors/) | Algorithmic approach to categorical palettes that stay distinct | For charts with many series: follow its method of maximising perceptual distance (CIELAB delta E) between categories while simulating colour-blindness (Brettel, Vienot and Mollon) and keeping WCAG contrast against the background, then check the result in Viz Palette. | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Data Color Picker (Learn UI Design)](https://www.learnui.design/tools/data-color-picker.html) | Generates evenly spaced palettes, single-hue scales and divergent scales for charts and dashboards | Start chart palettes here, then test the result in Viz Palette for colour-vision collisions. | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [iWantHue](https://medialab.github.io/iwanthue/) | Generates and refines sets of optimally distinct categorical colours inside a chosen hue, chroma and lightness range, with a colour-blind option | Constrain the colour space to the brand's range, generate the number of categories you need with 'improve for the colorblind' on, then sort by difference. | A | tool | static | free | [GitHub (medialab/iwanthue)](https://github.com/medialab/iwanthue) |
| [Scientific colour maps (Fabio Crameri)](https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps/) | Perceptually uniform, colour-blind-friendly scientific colour maps (batlow and family) that replace rainbow and jet scales | Use for heatmaps, maps and continuous scales; download the map for your tool (CSS, Python, R, ParaView and more) and cite the version. | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Viz Palette](https://projects.susielu.com/viz-palette) | Tests a data palette in real chart types under colour-vision deficiencies | Paste the categorical palette, then read the colour report: pairs that collide under each colour-vision deficiency and at small sizes are listed; adjust until none remain. | A | tool | js | free |  |
| [chroma.js palette helper](https://gka.github.io/palettes/) | Builds multi-hue sequential and diverging scales with lightness correction and a colour-blindness check | Use for sequential scales that must stay perceptually even (maps, heatmaps); turn on 'correct lightness' and check the colour-blind preview before exporting. | A | tool | js | free · slow |  |
| [Coloring for Colorblindness](https://davidmathlogic.com/colorblind/) | Simulates colour-vision deficiencies on a palette and offers known safe categorical palettes (Okabe-Ito, Wong, IBM) | Check a categorical palette here before shipping, or start from one of its safe palettes when the brand allows. | B | tool | js | free |  |
